title: Scripted clicks prove their effect: one verified move per walk write
deviations_from_card: Renamed per critic: simDoor.ts -> simMove.ts, SIM_DOORS -> SIM_MOVES, doorOutcome -> moveOutcome, engine.door -> engine.move, halt 'doorNoEffect' -> 'moveNoEffect', catalog keys log/error.moveNoEffect (+ wait.sourced, wait.hired). A 9th case added: a fallback on a non-(SIM) subject halts SIM_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND before the API runs. Fallback routing: no /api/sim/* door exists for publish, approve_event, offer accept or the candidate's /api/offer accept (the r02 doors are apply-cv, inbound, offer-draft, offer-link, reset, screen-draft), and adding four routes would blow the write set; so each move's fallback is gated CLIENT-side by simSubject() (isSimTitle on the board entry's jobTitle; the publish subject is the draft this run saved under SIM_TITLE) and still calls the product route. The existing sim doors (screen-draft, offer-draft, offer-link) are unchanged. Series is catalogs commit + ONE feat commit rather than test-then-feat: the source-scan cases (anchors, no bare POST) cannot be green without the product change, so a test-only commit would be red. simWalkSteps.clickRoute removed (its test case dropped) since moveOutcome supersedes it; the card's cites fixed to :62-66 / ~:55-61 by that removal. Small extra: the self-schedule catch now rethrows SimStop.
notes: test:perf exit 1 is NOT mine: 9 app/api/**/route.ts overages of 3-6 KB; walkGraph of those routes reaches only simulation/constants.ts (untouched) and none of my files; the tree has siblings' uncommitted edits to app/_lib/db/analytics.ts, schemas.ts, github/skills.ts, analytics-cache.ts on those paths. tsc exit 2 is all foreign (app/features/insights/analytics/* sibling in-flight, and the untracked kpi-sim/ copy); zero errors in my files. Full npm run test:unit green (exit 0). Not verified in a live browser (no dev server allowed): the decide -> candidate modal -> [role=dialog] accept path and the publish-confirm click are unit-pinned by source scan only; the coordinator's live smoke should watch one /?sim=auto run and check SimState.moves shows route 'dom' for publish and offerSend. Slot B builds on move()/SimState.moves.
